lesson.name: Learn The Slav Defense
lesson.description: The Slav is one of Black's safest and strongest defenses against the Queen's Gambit. Learn the key ideas and tactics for both sides.

{Black could defend b7 with Bc8, but there's a pawn sacrifice that's more
dynamic. What should Black play?} 6... Nc6 {[%wrong There's a better option.
Try again and look for a strong developing move.] [%hint Find the best square
for your b8-knight. Don't worry about the b7-pawn.]} (6... Bc8 $5 {This is a
solid, but passive option. See if you can find a developing move to sacrifice
a pawn for good compensation.}) (6... Qd7 $2 7. Nf3 {White prepares Ne5 to
attack the black queen and keep a dangerous initiative. Try again and look for
a stronger developing move.}) (6... e6 $2 7. Qxb7 {Black doesn't have enough
compensation for the sacrificed pawn. Try again and look for a stronger
developing move.}) (6... Qb6 $2 7. Nxd5 {White wins a pawn and Black doesn't
have compensation. Try again and look for a stronger developing move.}) (6...
Qc7 $2 7. Nxd5 {White wins a pawn and Black doesn't have compensation. Try
again and look for a stronger developing move.}) (6... Qc8 $2 7. Nxd5 {White
wins a pawn and Black doesn't have compensation. Try again and look for a
strong developing move.}) (6... Nbd7 $2 7. Nxd5 {White wins a pawn and Black
doesn't have compensation. Try again and look for a stronger knight move.}) (
6... Na6 $2 7. Qxb7 {The knight is poorly placed on a6 and Black is in trouble.
Try to find a better square for that piece.}) 7. Qxb7 {A great pawn sacrifice!
How should you save your knight?} Bd7 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try
again and look for the strongest way to protect c6.] [%hint Retreat a bishop
to defend your knight.] Well played! White will lose time retreating the queen
and Black has good compensation for the sacrificed pawn.} (7... Qc8 $2 8. Qxc8+
{Black doesn't have compensation for the sacrificed pawn. Try again and look
for a stronger way to defend the c6-knight.}) (7... Rc8 $2 8. Nf3 {Black
doesn't have compensation for the sacrificed pawn. Try again and look for a
stronger way to defend the c6-knight.}) *

{Black has captured a pawn on c4, but won't be able to keep it for long. How
should White win the pawn back?} 5. a4 {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking
idea. Try again and look for a way to break apart the black pawn chain.] 
[%hint Attack the c4-b5 pawn chain.]} (5. b3 $2 cxb3 {White has compensation
for the sacrificed pawn, but there's a better attacking idea. Try to find it.})
5... Nf6 {Good start! How can you break apart the black queenside?} 6. axb5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong forcing option.]
[%hint Trade pawns.]} (6. b3 $5 {This is OK, but let's insert a capture first.
Try to find a good one.}) (6. Nc3 $2 b4 {Black keeps a material advantage. Try
again and look for a more forcing option.}) (6. Na3 $2 a6 {Black keeps a
material advantage. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) 6... cxb5 {
White has started to break apart the queenside. How should you continue?} 7. b3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong pawn break.] 
[%hint Offer a trade for the c4-pawn.]} (7. Nc3 $5 {This is reasonable, but
there's a pawn break that's even stronger. Try to find it.}) 7... cxb3 {
Good choice! How should you win back your lost pawns?} 8. Bxb5+ {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for a precise capture.] [%hint
Capture a pawn with check.]} (8. Ne5 $5 {This is a good choice, but why not
capture something?}) (8. Qxb3 $2 b4 {White is doing well, but another capture
is even better. Try to find it.}) 8... Bd7 {Well played! What should you
capture next?} 9. Qxb3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for
a strong capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and defend your bishop.] Good work!
White has equalized material and keeps a lead in development and a large center.}
(9. Bxd7+ $2 Nbxd7 {White is doing well, but another capture is even better.
Try to find it.}) *

{White tried e2-e4 instead of the typical a2-a4. How can Black keep a material
advantage?} 5... b5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try again and look for a
way to keep a material edge.] [%hint Defend c4 with a pawn.]} (5... Bg4 $2 6.
Bxc4 {White wins back the pawn with a good position. Try again and look for a
way to keep a material advantage.}) (5... e5 $2 6. Bxc4 {White wins material.
Try again and look for a way to keep an extra pawn.}) (5... Be6 $2 6. Ng5 {
The bishop isn't safe on e6. Try again and look for a stronger way to defend c4.
}) 6. e5 {It's nice to have an extra pawn! How should you save your knight?}
Nd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for the most active
square for your f6-knight.] [%hint Centralize your f6-knight.]} 7. a4 {Good
choice! How should you continue to support your centralized knight?} e6 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a way to increase your
control of the central light squares.] [%hint Defend d5 with another pawn.]
Well done! White has some attacking chances, but less than full compensation
for the sacrificed pawn. That's why White typically takes a moment to play
a2-a4 to ensure that Black can't set up a queenside pawn chain.} (7... Qd7 $5 {
This is playable, but there's a pawn move that's stronger. Try to find it.}) (
7... Nxc3 $2 8. bxc3 {White has a strong center and good compensation for the
sacrificed pawn. Try again and look for a strong pawn move.}) (7... Bb7 $2 8. e6
{White sacrifices another pawn to launch a dangerous attack. Try again and
look for a way to prevent this pawn advance.}) (7... Be6 $2 8. Ng5 {The bishop
isn't safe on e6. Try to find something else to go there.}) (7... a6 $2 8. axb5
{White pins the a6-pawn with a good position. Try again and look for a
stronger pawn move.}) *

{In this wild position from the Exchange Slav White has a winning tactic. How
should you take advantage of the exposed black king?} 13. Qa4+ {[%wrong

knights. Try again and look for a stronger attacking idea.}) (13. Rc1 $2 Nxc3 {
Black is OK after the trade of knights. Try again and look for a stronger
attacking idea.}) 13... b5 {Great start! How should White continue the attack?}
14. Nxb5 {[%wrong There's a stronger attacking idea. Try again and look for a
powerful sacrifice.] [%hint Sacrifice your knight to prepare a deadly attack.]}
(14. Bxb5+ $2 axb5 {White doesn't have enough compensation for the sacrificed
piece. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 14... axb5 {Black's extra
material won't last for long. How should White keep up the attack?} 15. Bxb5+ {
[%wrong There's a better attacking idea. Try to find a winning check.] [%hint
